sessions.worktreeHelp: The daemon runs the session in a separate git checkout on a new branch (<branch>-wt) and places it under ~/.factory/worktrees on the PC; the location cannot be changed. Folders that are not git repositories open normally. The app does not remove worktrees: on the PC run `git worktree remove --force <path>` and `git branch -D <branch>-wt` in the repository when you are done.
